skills.description: Repair truncated or malformed AI output (JSON, HTML, SVG, CSS) before any JSON.parse or DOMParser runs. Use when a model reply fails to parse, is cut at max tokens or arrives with empty tool arguments; emits a RepairReport of what was fixed and what could not be.

Abstract a challenge to its functional pattern and retrieve three or more named analogues from adjacent industries that solved or failed at the same problem. Use when within-industry retrieval keeps returning the same evidence and a recommendation needs outside precedent.

Formatting contract for plain, non-hashtag chat replies on the Analyst and Designer desks: headers, bullets, numbered lists, blockquotes and bold in the ChatProse renderer. Use for conversational answers; hashtag deliverables follow the deck and render contracts.

Technical architecture illustrator. Use the matching exemplar (styles/03-architecture-NU.html or 04-architecture-NXT.html) as visual ground truth. Adapt systems, components, and data flows to the corpus.

Router for the HiC skill library. Use when you know what you want to do but not which skill does it, or when starting any multi-step HiC job (a research run, an artifact, a prototype, a QA pass, a self-improvement pass) and you want the right skills in the right order.
Generate a structured before/after comparison for any code or prompt change. Shows exactly what changed, why, and the impact on output quality.
Extract three or four hero metrics with named sources and render them as a stat row; every number travels inside an attributed quote. Used for benchmark, metrics and by-the-numbers requests.

Service blueprint (FUTURE-state) illustrator. Frames the workflow as the proposed redesign post-analysis. Shares visual exemplar with journey (styles/01-service-blueprint-NU.html and 02-service-blueprint-NXT.html); diverges semantically.

Write a two-voice text dialogue (Skeptical Partner and Curious Strategist) of 600 to 900 words on a finding or recommendation set, every line cited to corpus chunks. Use when a partner wants a fast, argued read of the evidence instead of a report.
Named, evidence-grounded case studies from the corpus -- subject, context, intervention, outcome, and applicability -- each anchored to verbatim quotes and named external sources.

Stage changes and produce a pre-commit report (slop scan of staged HiC files, rebuild reminder, diff stat) without committing. Use before asking the owner to approve a commit; the commit itself waits for explicit approval.
Dual-mode competitive landscape analysis combining named entity extraction with archetype analysis, benchmark scoring, maturity matrix, and gap summary.
Audit a prompt and replace every vague instruction with a specific, measurable constraint. Vague equals failure.

Surface where sources in a corpus disagree on a claim: the surface consensus, three contradictions with both sides quoted, the weakest claim and the unresolved debate. Use when a theme or recommendation cites only supporting evidence and needs counter-evidence engaged.

Wrap a deliverable draft in a generator, critic and revisor loop: critics emit structured edits, the revisor applies them, and the loop stops when every critic accepts or the budget runs out. Use to run pre-mortem, stakeholder-lens or contradiction critics over a draft.

Mine prior sessions and synthesis pages for patterns that recur across engagements and write the signal-only cross-engagement-patterns page that generation context injects. Use after several runs of one deliverable type or industry, or on the scheduled curation pass.

The authority for #slides, #strategy and #presentation deck composition: archetype choice by content shape, the visual floor and variety rules, the Minto, Rumelt and SCQA arc, title craft and subject discipline. Injected whole into the DECK MODE prompt.
Turn a single monolithic prompt into a multi-phase skill system with distinct phases, explicit handoffs, and output checkpoints between each phase.

Match a prototype brief and its brand hashtag to the strongest Behance exemplars and pick one verbalized-sampling framing per match. Loaded by #proto Stage 3 (visual direction) and Stage 4 (prototype coder) so the design direction cites real references.

Runtime visual router for deliverable image slots: chooses per slot between a native exhibit render, a content-true icon or a generated illustration, bound by the HiC Design Laws. Use when a deliverable declares image slots whose lane the archetype registry has not fixed.

Determinism contract for every call that names a deliverable's identity fields (theme, persona, recommendation and slide titles, cluster labels): a signature-keyed response cache plus frozen inputs, so the same cached corpus and goal give the same names.
Diagnose failure patterns in any prompt and map each failure to a structural fix. Use when a prompt is producing inconsistent, incorrect, or incomplete outputs.
Compare outputs across multiple runs to detect format drift, quality degradation, or inconsistency. Use to validate prompt stability.

The Step-7 self-improvement epoch proposer: reads traces, Pareto vectors and the golden-set baseline, proposes one bounded harness edit, runs the gate and applies it only if accepted. Fires when jobs since the last epoch reach k (default 5).
Validate Power Automate escape chains for Claude API HTTP actions. Catches the 4-step escape failures that cause 400 errors in PA flows.
Surface one powerful verbatim quote with full attribution and source context, rendered as a block quote. Used when one piece of testimony carries the argument better than a summary would.

Audit the corpus before theme, persona or recommendation generation and predict how many thick-evidence themes it supports; below the floor, run upstream remediation (query expansion, analogues, framework pages) instead of relaxing the gate.

Compose every #proto Stage 4 prototype region from a named pattern in the AI Experience Patterns catalog (wiki inspiration-hub/ai-patterns) in the requested brand. Loaded by the Stage 4 prototype coder beside the exemplar curator.

Long-form HTML explainer that answers one question end to end about a concept, technology, framework or operating model: definitions, mechanism, examples and named-source evidence, with a 1,200 visible-word floor. Use for #explainer.

Paint-readiness contract for the legacy html2canvas export path: wait for fonts, decoded images, flushed effects and two stable frames before capture, so PPTX, PDF and PNG exports never ship blank slides. Use when touching exportService or a blank-slide bug.
Log, classify, and analyze failures from flow runs, API calls, or deployments. Builds a structured failure history that informs future prompt improvements.

Turn silent provider and pipeline fallbacks into structured GenerationReceipt degradation events the user sees in the chat. Use when wiring a fallback chain (model substitution, embedding fallback, depth timeout) so a degraded path is always named.
Four-step capability gap extraction using Gartner 5-level maturity scoring with evidence-backed severity, risk register, and quick wins.

Background git discipline for this workbench: never merge to main, branch from the latest feature branch, never commit without the owner's explicit approval. Read it whenever a task touches git; the user does not invoke it directly.
Add failure prevention layers to existing code or prompts. Builds guardrails that catch problems before they cause downstream failures.

Rebuild the HiC research-generator container after a frontend edit and verify the new bundle is served by fetching it and checking a marker string. Use when a change under humans-in-control-research needs to be seen live; the nginx container has no hot reload.

Start a HiC deliverable from outside HiC and get the report back: a signed call to the proxy's inbound webhook queues an allow-listed job and POSTs the result to a callback. Use when another agent platform, or a Claude Code session without the proxy token, delegates a deliverable.

The nine-phase operational contract for HiC: how the eight Unified Vision principles bind at each phase, from objective grounding to native PPTX. Read it before non-trivial pipeline, retrieval, routing, design-system or self-improvement work.

Generate brand-locked, self-contained HTML deliverables (briefs, explainers, reports, playgrounds, approach pickers) for human review, applying verbalized sampling across layout, structure, diagram, interaction and iconography. Used for #brief, #explainer, #report.

The positive half of HiC's writing contract: register, audience calibration (executive, practitioner, mixed) and sentence economy. Load beside any authoring skill and whenever the prose signal flags cadence, openers, actors, copula or dilution.

Generate one minimalist flat-vector illustration per #presentation scene, tied to the scene's content and limited to the brand palette from the design tokens. The #presentation lane only; deck and artifact image slots route through the designer skill.

Authoring contract for slides:infographic-exhibit panels - data-dense, evidence-true native infographics composed from the slide's own corpus content. Injected into DECK MODE so every infographic carries real substance, never bare labels in empty frames.

Current-state journey map illustrator with a draft-then-deepen two-pass method: grid-table HTML with per-cell verbatim evidence and sources, named touchpoints, emotion intensity and a journey-level KPI dashboard. Used for #journey; NXT and NU differ only in color and type.
Eliminate output format drift by designing an airtight output specification with locked sections, labels, and length rules. Use when outputs vary in structure between runs.

Wrapper pattern for any HiC browser-to-backend call that can run past ten seconds: an immediate in-flight chat message, an AbortSignal with a bounded timeout and the fast model by default. Use when wiring a chat directive to a slow endpoint.
How every HiC generator pulls evidence from the wiki via manifest chunk pointers instead of bulk body injection. Replaces RAG.

Scaffold a new MCP wrapper and core service for the workbench: a JSON-RPC 2.0 wrapper under mcp-services, the compose entry on nxt-humans-network, the agent's tool_services URL and the restart command. Use when adding a service the platform agent should reach.

Surface themes that recur across three or more engagements as portfolio patterns (five or more as platform patterns) from each engagement's themes and the cross-engagement patterns page. Use when a partner asks what the portfolio keeps finding.

Turn topic-model clusters and the research goal into a nested mind map, at most four levels deep and seven children per node, each node carrying chunk references for click-to-chat drill-down. Use when a corpus needs a navigable concept map.

Compose an image-model prompt that renders a full-bleed 16:9 consulting diagram (journey, architecture, mind map, service blueprint) with every dimension and corpus-verbatim text injected from the deliverable data. Used by the proxy's diagram prompt path.

Northeastern University brand-style skill for freeform-HTML diagram artifacts. Editorial layer (voice, anti-patterns, when-to-use). Visual tokens are inherited from the exemplar HTML files at humans-in-control-research/styles/.

Generate PowerPoint decks in the NXT Humans brand (flat minimalism, token typography, chartreuse and cyan accents) from 15 codified slide templates. Use for NXT-branded slides produced outside the HiC app, such as turning a report into a house-style deck.

Generate flat, text-free, token-locked SVG data visualizations for NXT and NU deck and artifact image slots (operating model, maturity, funnel, roadmap, KPI gauge). The data-viz lane only; conceptual panels route to the native infographic lane.

NXT Humans brand-style skill for freeform-HTML diagram artifacts. Editorial layer (voice, anti-patterns, when-to-use). Visual tokens (colors, typography, atmospheric treatment) are inherited from the exemplar HTML files at humans-in-control-research/styles/.

Layout, density and quote-handling contract for the 18 web slide templates and their PPTX export, shared by the NXT and NU brand variants. Loaded as a render contract when slide or template intent appears; budgets and JSON shapes live in references/web-layouts.md.

Brand-locked organizational structure diagram for a named institution, vendor or initiative: roles, reporting lines, named stakeholders and decision authorities, each node cited. Describes what exists today and renders as a CSS-grid diagram.

Org chart illustrator skill. Use the matching exemplar (styles/05-org-chart-NU.html or 06-org-chart-NXT.html) as the literal visual ground truth. Adapt the content (people, roles, reporting lines) to the corpus; preserve the frame, typography, atmospheric washes.

Generate evidence-grounded CX personas in two phases (a verbalized-sampling roster, then enrichment) on a Cooper goal hierarchy, with three or more named external citations, verbatim quotes and jobs-to-be-done per persona. Used for #personas.

Compile the one PRD contract (PrdAir, spec v2026) from typed AIR references: two tiers, twelve sections, a Source to Signal traceability graph, evidence-derived MoSCoW tiers, seven-field success signals, and the typed requirement_target number rule. Document first; the deck is a projection.

Assume a recommendation failed badly 18 months out and reason backward to its failure modes (political resistance, lock-in, change fatigue, integration regret, talent flight, regulatory reversal). Produces a likelihood-by-severity risk register entry per recommendation.
Full pre-deployment audit combining prompt scoring, stress testing, and constraint validation. Run this before deploying any prompt to production.
Validate any AI-generated output against its expected schema before delivery. Catches truncated HTML, invalid JSON, missing sections, and format violations.

Give every recommendation the finance-grade four-tuple: a sourced baseline, a dated target, a named measurement method and a refresh cadence. Use when recommendations or roadmap items must be approvable by a finance committee.

Use for #questionnaire. Turns a decision the corpus cannot settle into questions for the person who holds the answer. Reach for it when research has narrowed a choice but the deciding fact sits with a stakeholder, not in a document.

Per-provider token-bucket pacing for HiC's external API calls, so a 429 from one provider throttles only that provider: how concurrency drops on a 429, how long to back off and when to ease back up. Use when touching proxy concurrency or a rate-limit cascade.

Generate consulting-grade AI-tool recommendations grounded in client uploads and stakeholder constraints: extract the engagement context, then produce 5 to 12 distinct recommendations that honor every constraint with implementation depth. Used for #recs.

Re-ask the model with its prior answer verbatim plus an uncertainty hint when confidence crosses a threshold; anchored re-asking beats a plain think-harder prompt. Use at regeneration sites (recommendations, journey map, PRD, roadmap, gap analysis) and uncertain answers.

Turn a research goal, an uploaded brief and institution context into a structured research plan (sub-questions, source strategy, institutions, expected theme count, budget cap, reflection threshold) that the user edits and approves before collection runs.
Build evidence-based implementation roadmaps using NOW/NEXT/LATER horizon framework with problem framing
Roadmap illustrator. Use the matching exemplar (styles/07-roadmap-NU.html or 08-roadmap-NXT.html) as visual ground truth. Produce phases / milestones / now-next-later / Gantt-style timelines.
Score any prompt across 5 reliability dimensions before it goes into production. Flags launch risks. Use before deploying any system prompt.

Map second-order, third-order, unintended and feedback-loop consequences of a recommendation or decision: three moves ahead, one named unintended consequence and the loop that amplifies or undermines the move. Use to deepen strategy actions and roadmap phases.
Claude reviews its own planned changes against the original request before executing. Catches scope creep, over-engineering, and missed requirements.
Generate persona-driven service blueprints with Bitner 5-component model, fail points, and emotion intensity

Run the 15-symptom HiC log-audit checklist against a named Docker service's logs and map each hit to the validator hook that catches it. Use when a chat is slow, a generator fails, a stage returns empty or a 400 or 500 shows up.

Audit every SkillOpt-proposed skill edit against the eight-check rubric before it reaches .claude/skills, and emit APPROVE, BLOCK or HUMAN-REVIEW per proposal. Use when a training pass emits proposed edits or any pipeline proposes changing a SKILL.md.
The canonical slide template set, rendered in the NXT or NU brand chosen by hashtag, with the deliverable skill that owns each template. Loaded as the rendering system when slide intent appears.

Generate 15 candidate action titles for one slide across eight formats, score them against the title rules and return the top three plus the weakest dimension. Use when a slide title reads as a topic label or one-shot titles keep failing the title gate.

Rank candidate sources on credibility, recency, relevance to the argument and external, client or synthetic class; emit Use, Verify or Cut per source, the top three, the one to cut and the missing source type. Enforces the external-source floors.

Score data collection, not output: aggregate the proxy's connector-health ledger into per-source reliability and yield scores and write source-scores.md, which research-planner reads to deprioritize dead connectors. Run on a weekly cadence.

Run every recommendation through five stakeholder lenses (CIO or CTO, CFO, customer officer, frontline owner, regulator or risk officer) and emit an objections-and-responses appendix per recommendation. Use before a recommendation set meets a multi-stakeholder audience.
McKinsey-format strategic whitepaper synthesis using Rumelt's Kernel, 20+ named sources, case studies, social evidence, and mandatory section manifest driven by available deliverables.
Author strategic recommendations using Rumelt's Kernel and generate 15-section strategy documents with quantified impact
Generate adversarial inputs to break any prompt or code, scoring each failure by severity. Use before deploying prompts or shipping features.
Two-phase technology architecture extraction from research corpus using C4 Model node/flow mapping with citations per component.
Two-phase technology ecosystem audit producing systems inventory, integration map, capability matrix, and consolidation opportunities.
Extract strategic themes from multi-source research corpus using 6-lens thematic analysis

Theme count comes from topic clustering reading the corpus, not from policy: the topic model finds clusters, the model names them, and the citation, source and evidence gates run at naming time with no relaxation tiers. Use when theme yield is low.

Primary theme generator: deterministic topic clustering (fixed UMAP seed, auto-scaled HDBSCAN) finds 15 to 25 clusters and the model names each from top terms and example documents, so the same cached corpus and goal give the same themes. Used for #themes.
Strip every word that weakens a prompt without adding precision. Cuts qualifiers, redundancy, and filler to improve output reliability.

Ask the model for a verbalized probability distribution over k candidates instead of one answer, recovering diversity lost to typicality bias. Apply at creative and synthesis points (themes, recommendations, prototype concepts, personas, slide narrative).

Expand one question into three or four conceptually distinct query variants, run one fetch_wiki_articles call per variant and merge the results, so each variant reaches a different neighborhood of the embedding space. Use when a single query misses articles.

After fetch_wiki_articles returns candidates, re-read the question, score each article 1 to 5 on direct intent relevance and cite only articles scoring 4 or 5. Use when retrieval returns near-duplicates, off-topic siblings or surface matches with the wrong intent.

For broad questions spanning many articles: retrieve from three distinct angles, extract verbatim quotes, cluster them by theme and present an answer-first Minto synthesis. Use for synthesize, tell me everything about or build a picture of; not single-fact lookups.
